about: What each smiley sticker on Aaron's arm does (docs/nfc-show-controls.md). A tag holds only its id (s1..s8); this file maps ids to actions, so re-assigning a sticker is an edit here, never a rewrite of the tag. `do`: keep | panic | next | prev | take | drop | set. `set` sends its object as update-params (a shader and/or knobs). A show's `stickers` override the base map; its beats come from setlists/<show>.json when that file exists, else `beats` here. PANIC sends no fork (the display uses its own boot fork) unless a panic sticker names `fork`.
